<div class="title-container">
  <h1>Art by Priti</h1>
  <h2>An Online Gallery</h2>
</div>

<div class="gallery">
  <figure class="gallery-item">
    <h3><a href="/art1" onclick="openImagePage(event, 'art1')">Geometry and Divinity</a></h3>
    <img class="thumbnail" src="images/art1.jpg" alt="Artwork 1">
    <p class="image-size">(91 cm x 61 cm)</p>
    <figcaption>Geometry and divinity – both can calm and inspire. The beauty of polka dots encased within the beauty of Ganesha.</figcaption>
  </figure>

  <figure class="gallery-item">
    <h3><a href="/art2" onclick="openImagePage(event, 'art2')">Poppies by the Canal</a></h3>
    <img class="thumbnail" src="images/art2.jpg" alt="Artwork 2">
    <p class="image-size">(80 cm x 50 cm)</p>
    <figcaption>While riding with my son on a bicycle to the Dutch nursery...</figcaption>
  </figure>

  <figure class="gallery-item">
    <h3><a href="/art3" onclick="openImagePage(event, 'art3')">Mondrian Influence</a></h3>
    <img class="thumbnail" src="images/art3.jpg" alt="Artwork 3">
    <p class="image-size">(100 cm x 75 cm)</p>
    <figcaption>This was done during a time when I felt like I was a willing and eager captive to Mondrian’s works.</figcaption>
  </figure>
</div>

<div id="image-page" class="image-page" style="display: none;">
  <span class="close" onclick="closeImagePage()">&times;</span>
  <img class="expanded-image" id="fullImage">
  <div class="comment-section" id="commentSection">
    <h3>Leave a Comment</h3>
    <textarea id="commentBox" placeholder="Write your comment..."></textarea>
    <button onclick="submitComment()">Submit</button>
    <div id="commentsList" class="comments-list"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
function openImagePage(event, imageId) {
    event.preventDefault();
    history.pushState({ page: imageId }, "", "/" + imageId);
    showImageFromURL();
}

function showImageFromURL() {
    let path = window.location.pathname.substring(1);
    if (path.startsWith("art")) {
        document.querySelector(".gallery").style.display = "none";
        document.getElementById("image-page").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("fullImage").src = `images/${path}.jpg`;

        // Ensure the comment section is correctly inserted
        let commentSection = document.getElementById("commentSection");
        commentSection.innerHTML = `
            <h3>Leave a Comment</h3>
            <textarea id="commentBox" placeholder="Write your comment..."></textarea>
            <button onclick="submitComment()">Submit</button>
            <div id="commentsList" class="comments-list"></div>
        `;
        commentSection.style.display = "block";
    } else {
        showHomePage();
    }
}

function closeImagePage() {
    history.pushState(null, "", "/");
    showHomePage();
}

function showHomePage() {
    let gallery = document.querySelector(".gallery");
    gallery.style.display = "grid";  // Ensures proper arrangement
    gallery.style.gridTemplateColumns = "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr))";
    gallery.style.gap = "20px";
    gallery.style.justifyContent = "center";

    gallery.style.visibility = "visible";
    document.getElementById("image-page").style.display = "none";
}

// Handle browser back button
window.addEventListener("popstate", function (event) {
    if (event.state && event.state.page) {
        showImageFromURL(); // Go back to the correct image page
    } else {
        showHomePage(); // Reset layout when returning to home page
    }
});

function submitComment() {
    let commentText = document.getElementById("commentBox").value;
    if (commentText.trim() !== "") {
        let commentList = document.getElementById("commentsList");
        let newComment = document.createElement("p");
        newComment.textContent = commentText;
        commentList.appendChild(newComment);
        document.getElementById("commentBox").value = "";
    }
}


</script>

<style>
.image-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 20px;
}
.expanded-image {
    max-width: 80%;
    height: auto;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.comment-section {
    margin-top: 20px;
    width: 60%;
    background: #f9f9f9;
    padding: 15px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0px 0px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    display: block;
}
textarea {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    padding: 10px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    border: 1px solid #ccc;
}
button {
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background-color: #007bff;
    color: white;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 5px;
    cursor: pointer;
}
button:hover {
    background-color: #0056b3;
}
.comments-list {
    margin-top: 15px;
    padding: 10px;
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 5px;
    box-shadow: 0px 0px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}
</style>
